Behind him, dark wooden shelves stocked with various glass jars remain stationary. To the left, a large paneed window with dark bars overlooks a sun-drenched city street with golden-toned buildings and a leafy tree. Outside the window, three small figures in hats and coats are walking across the street from right to left. As the video progresses, the first figure walks behind the window bars and exits the frame, followed shortly by the second figure at 00:02.000, who also passes behind the bars and disappears. Finally, the third figure passes at 00:04.500, leaving the street outside empty. Throughout the entire shot, the shopkeeper (S1) remains perfectly still, looking out toward the window, while the interior lighting, golden hour shadows, and textured surfaces of the shop remain completely unchanging, converging on the final frame where the street is deserted.
